name: Love & Chaos
overview: An ambitious management consultant and a young IT technician who, at first glance, could hardly be more different: Sophie, a successful career woman, married, mother of two children, is significantly older than Max, who, with his relaxed outlook on life, seems almost charmingly youthful. What begins as a harmless fling quickly turns into a passionate, unconventional relationship that pushes both of them to surpass themselves.
